sources.title: Batch 0060 frozen RocketMQ consumption-mode repository context
Apache RocketMQ official consumption-mode primary-source research packet

claims.text: For the classic RocketMQ MessageModel/interview meaning of consumption mode, the candidate answers two modes: Clustering and Broadcasting.

The answer states that consumers in one Consumer Group share work in Clustering mode, so a message is handled by one consumer in that group and group capacity can be scaled through load-balanced consumers subject to allocation limits.
The answer states that Broadcasting gives each consumer in the group the full subscribed message stream, so adding consumers duplicates full-stream processing rather than dividing one workload.

The candidate separates cluster/broadcast MessageModel from Push/Pull or current consumer types and from concurrent/orderly processing, and scopes the DefaultMQPushConsumer default-clustering statement to the 4.x Java PushConsumer documentation.
